title: MV Advice for a Monster Capture Game

posts.author: Guardinthena
posts.body:
Engine: MV
My son recently expressed to me that he wants to make his very first RPG game and that he wants it similar to Pokemon in the game mechanics to capture enemies and turn them to allies.  I am not sure how to do everything he wants and was hoping the community could help me make my boy happy in realizing his dream.
So far, I have found
Aerosys's amazing plugins: Pet Summoning, Deck Addon and Menu Addon
that turn Actors into pets with a notetag and the main player or other players into summoners.  The deck Addon provides a new scene where the player can organize the pets into a team, and the Menu Addon provides another new scene similar to a Pokedex or compendium.
I was feeling pretty proud when I found Aerosys's plugins, then it hit me like a ton of bricks last night that I had forgotten a major element: the monster capture system and evolution.
I ran across
Synrec's Monster Capture plugin and Farming.
Downloaded the demo but there's errors in the demo.  Does anyone know if it works well with Aerosys's plugins?  Or if it's redundant to have Aerosys's with Synrec?
Does anyone have any additional advice on what I may need to build a monster capture style game that I have overlooked?  I have never built a game with these mechanics and not sure everything I will need.  Any and all advice or personal experience with the subject would be grateful.

posts.author: LordOfPotatos
posts.body:
if you aren't sure if you can fix Synrec's plugins AND make them work with Aerosys' (which might be it's own can of worms), I'd recommend taking Aerosys' plugins and trying to make the capture process work through eventing.
if you don't mind only having 1 of each enemy on your captured collection it's pretty easy. if you need to make dupes possible it's doable but you might need a tutorial or two.
if the child has to get a handle on this... well if you can make it work and teach him the framework making the rest of the game will be easy.
as for advice, do not make the world map first. you'll realize it's too big and there are too many locations halfway through making the game.
also, might want to ask about those plugins on the JS support boards. just in case you get lucky.

posts.author: Guardinthena
posts.body:
Thank you.  I hadn't thought of going to the JS support boards just yet.  I am just discovering a lot of these plugins today and haven't had a lot of time to invest in figuring out what's going on with Synrec's yet.  Let alone checking out the rest.  Just found out about DreamX's Capture Enemies plugin and how people have used that in combination with Yanfly's Party System and Level Up Growth Effects plugins to achieve the capture and evolution bits.
It's been just a day of taking in a lot of information for me tbh.  Trying to figure out what works best, if certain older plugins still work, etc, before I even think about teaching my son.  I had him sit with my yesterday as I figured out Aerosync's plugins, that alone had my son realizing there is a lot of work involved.
